notes: This minor release makes specify and plan routing local-first, delegates knowledge extraction and planning aspects only on positive unit-local triggers, removes redundant capacity and routing projections, and introduces compact plan-stage-report@4, specification-stage-report@2 and eval-report-data@3 contracts. Legacy report versions remain readable. No canonical path or persistent runtime migration is required, but upgrades should use targeted minor review because routing defaults and report writers changed.
